answer: Post a bond per identity at registration and burn it when a recruit's task fails audit. Trust attaches to the task, not the address, so a recycled name buys nothing. A nebula of 1,000 identities at 50 POA each puts 50,000 POA at risk, and one failed audit in a hollow account burns the full bond. Seeding that meadow costs 50,000 POA before a single payout lands.
